text:
Maria L: Quick follow-up from the KV-cache eviction postmortem — we need to lock owners, tickets, and a short RACI so this doesn't slip. Who can pick up the main remediation?
Kevin T: I can own the primary remediation work (kv cache auto-evict tuning).
Sophie P: I'll take QA + rollout verification (can do canary tests and perf regression).
Raj K: I'll be accountable for infra changes and the deployment playbook.
Maria L: Thanks. Can we get a Jira for tracking? Prefer a single epic linking subtasks.
oncall-bot: Created ticket PM-4821: "KV cache eviction — remediation epic" (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PM-4821)
Kevin T: Added subtasks: PM-4822 (investigate histograms + thresholds), PM-4823 (autoscaler policy update), PM-4824 (kv caching metrics + alerts).
Sophie P: I'll open QA test plans under PM-4825 and link to the epic.
Maria L: RACI suggestion: Responsible=Kevin, Accountable=Raj, Consulted=Sophie, Informed=oncall + eng-sre. Okay?
Raj K: Agree. Please add the RACI table as a comment on the epic so handoffs are clear.
Kevin T: Timeline proposal: investigation by EoW (5 business days), autoscaler change in 2 sprints, alerts and dashboard updates within sprint 1.
Sophie P: Can we make the canary window 48h with 1% traffic? Will validate latency and error regressions.
Maria L: That sounds reasonable. Also want a recurrence analysis task to confirm pattern (weekly spikes for 3 months) — assign to Kevin.
Kevin T: Assigned PM-4826 "recurrence analysis: 3-month KV eviction pattern" to myself. I'll share a short notebook by Friday.
Raj K: Need to coordinate with Dedicated infra team for capacity tests — tagging @kevin to ping infra slack.
Kevin T: Will ping infra and create a shared doc for runbook changes.
Sophie P: Quick checklist for rollout: canary, synthetic load, dashboard smoke, postmortem update. I'll manage the checklist and mark sign-offs in the epic.
Maria L: Who will own post-release verification and close the epic? Recommend Sophie to verify and Raj to close once infra changes are in prod.
Sophie P: Happy to verify and mark the epic Verified.
Raj K: I'll close the epic after infra validation and confirm in #postmortems.
Maria L: Great. Can everyone comment on the epic with their acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow? If no blockers, we'll target the investigation milestone this Friday.
Kevin T: Will add ACs to PM-4822 by EOD.
Sophie P: ACs for QA posted.
Raj K: Infra ACs posted.
Maria L: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short weekly cadence to track status until closure. :thumbsup:
Kevin T: FYI flagged as high-impact — will escalate if we see reoccurrence before fixes land.
Sophie P: adding a regression alert to the dashboard so we don't miss early signals.
Maria L: Closing loop: next check-in Friday 10am PT in this thread.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem follow-up check-in — Fri 10:00 PT (3176870400)
